verses.text: Aleph. Happy are those who live blameless lives, who follow the LORD's law.
Happy are those who keep his laws and look for him with all their hearts.
They do nothing wrong. They follow his ways.
You have given us your rules so that we would obey them completely.
I wish my ways were steady in keeping your laws!
Then I would not be put to shame when I think about all your commands.
I will thank you with an honest heart as I learn your fair judgments.
I will keep your laws. Do not ever leave me.
Beth. How can a young person keep their life pure? By living as your word says.
I look for you with all my heart. Do not let me wander away from your commands.
I have stored up your word in my heart so I will not sin against you.
Praise be to you, LORD. Teach me your laws.
With my lips I tell about all the judgments you have spoken.
I enjoy following your laws as much as having great riches.
I will think about your rules and pay attention to your ways.
I take delight in your laws. I will not forget your word.
Gimel. Be good to me, your servant, so I may live and obey your word.
Open my eyes so I can see the wonderful things in your law.
I am a stranger on earth. Do not hide your commands from me.
My soul is worn out with longing for your judgments all the time.
You scold proud people who are cursed, those who wander away from your commands.
Take away the insults and shame people give me, because I have kept your laws.
Even when rulers sit together and speak against me, I, your servant, will think about your laws.
Your laws are my delight. They are my advisers.
Daleth. I am lying face down in the dust. Give me new life, as your word promises!
I told you about my life, and you answered me. Teach me your laws.
Help me understand what your rules teach. Then I will think about your amazing works.
My soul is tired and sad. Give me strength, as your word promises.
Keep me away from lies. Be kind and teach me your law.
I have chosen the way of truth. I have set my heart on your judgments.
I hold on tightly to your laws, LORD. Do not let me be put to shame.
I run along the path of your commands, because you have set my heart free.
He. Teach me, LORD, to follow your laws, and I will keep them to the end.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. I will obey it with all my heart.
Lead me along the path of your commands, because I love them.
Turn my heart toward your laws and not toward selfish gain.
Turn my eyes away from worthless things. Give me new life as I follow your ways.
Keep your promise to me, your servant, so that people will respect you.
Take away the shame I am afraid of, because your judgments are good.
Look how I long for your rules! Give me new life because you do what is right.
Vav. LORD, let your faithful love come to me, and your rescue, as you promised.
Then I will have an answer for those who insult me, because I trust in your word.
Do not take the word of truth away from my mouth, because I put my hope in your judgments.
I will always obey your law, forever and ever.
I will walk around in freedom, because I have looked for your rules.
I will speak about your laws in front of kings, and I will not be ashamed.
I take delight in your commands, because I love them.
I lift up my hands to your commands, which I love. I will think about your laws.
Zayin. Remember your promise to me, your servant, because it has given me hope.
This is my comfort when I suffer: your promise gives me life.
Proud people make fun of me terribly, but I do not turn away from your law.
LORD, I remember your judgments from long ago, and they comfort me.
I burn with anger because of the wicked, who have turned away from your law.
Your laws have been my songs in the place where I live.
LORD, I remember your name at night, and I keep your law.
This is how I live: I obey your rules.
Heth. The LORD is all I need. I have promised to obey your words.
I have looked for your kindness with all my heart. Be kind to me, as you promised.
I thought about how I was living, and I turned my steps to follow your laws.
I will hurry, without delay, to obey your commands.
The wicked have tied me up with ropes, but I will not forget your law.
At midnight I get up to thank you, because your judgments are right.
I am a friend to everyone who respects you, to everyone who obeys your rules.
LORD, the earth is full of your faithful love. Teach me your laws.
Teth. LORD, you have been good to me, your servant, as you promised.
Teach me good sense and knowledge, because I believe in your commands.
Before I suffered, I wandered off, but now I obey your word.
You are good, and you do what is good. Teach me your laws.
Proud people have smeared me with lies, but I keep your rules with all my heart.
Their hearts are hard and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.
It was good for me to suffer, so I could learn your laws.
The law you have spoken is worth more to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Yodh. Your hands made me and formed me. Give me understanding so I can learn your commands.
May those who respect you be glad when they see me, because I have put my hope in your word.
LORD, I know that your judgments are right, and that you made me suffer because you are faithful.
May your faithful love comfort me, as you promised me, your servant.
Show me your tender mercy so I may live, because your law is my delight.
Let proud people be put to shame for hurting me with lies. I will think about your rules.
Let those who respect you turn to me, those who understand your laws.
May my heart be blameless in following your laws, so I will not be put to shame.
Kaph. I am worn out waiting for you to rescue me. I put my hope in your word.
My eyes are tired from looking for what you promised. I ask, "When will you comfort me?"
I am like a wineskin dried out in the smoke, but I do not forget your laws.
How long must I, your servant, wait? When will you punish those who chase me?
Proud people have dug pits to trap me. They do not follow your law.
All your commands can be trusted. People are chasing me for no reason. Help me!
They almost wiped me off the earth, but I have not turned away from your rules.
Keep me alive because of your faithful love, so I can obey the laws you have spoken.
Lamedh. LORD, your word lasts forever. It stands firm in heaven.
Your faithfulness continues for all generations. You set the earth in place, and it stays there.
Your laws still stand today, because everything serves you.
If your law had not been my delight, I would have died in my suffering.
I will never forget your rules, because by them you have given me life.
I belong to you. Save me, because I have looked for your rules.
Wicked people are waiting to destroy me, but I will think about your laws.
I have seen that everything has its limits, but your commands have no limit.
Mem. How I love your law! I think about it all day long.
Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, because they are always with me.
I understand more than all my teachers, because I think about your laws.
I understand more than the old people, because I obey your rules.
I have kept my feet from every evil path, so that I can obey your word.
I have not turned away from your judgments, because you yourself have taught me.
How sweet your promises taste to me! They are sweeter than honey in my mouth.
I get understanding from your rules, so I hate every path that is false.
Nun. Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my path.
I have made a promise and I will keep it: I will obey your fair judgments.
I am suffering very much. LORD, give me new life, as your word promises.
LORD, please accept the praise I gladly offer, and teach me your judgments.
My life is always in danger, but I will not forget your law.
Wicked people have set a trap for me, but I have not wandered from your rules.
Your laws are my treasure forever. They are the joy of my heart.
I have set my heart on obeying your laws forever, to the very end.
Samekh. I hate people who cannot make up their minds, but I love your law.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I put my hope in your word.
Get away from me, you evil people, so I can keep the commands of my God.
Hold me up as you promised, so I will live. Do not let my hope be disappointed.
Hold me up, and I will be safe. I will always respect your laws.
You reject all who wander away from your laws, because their lies are useless.
You throw away all the wicked of the earth like waste metal. So I love your laws.
My body trembles because I am afraid of you. I am in awe of your judgments.
Ayin. I have done what is fair and right. Do not leave me to those who want to crush me.
Promise that things will go well for me, your servant. Do not let proud people crush me.
My eyes are tired from looking for your rescue, for your promise to make things right.
Treat me, your servant, with faithful love. Teach me your laws.
I am your servant. Give me understanding so I can know your laws.
LORD, it is time for you to act, because people are breaking your law.
So I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold.
So I believe all your rules are right. I hate every path that is false.
Pe. Your laws are wonderful, so I obey them with all my heart.
When your words are explained, they give light. They give understanding to simple people.
I open my mouth and pant, because I long for your commands.
Turn to me and be kind to me, as you always are to those who love your name.
Guide my steps by your word. Do not let any sin control me.
Rescue me from people who would crush me, so I can obey your rules.
Let your face shine on me, your servant. Teach me your laws.
Rivers of tears flow from my eyes, because people do not obey your law.
Tsadhe. LORD, you always do what is right, and your judgments are fair.
The laws you have given are right and completely trustworthy.
My deep love for your laws wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
Your promises have been completely tested, and I, your servant, love them.
I am unimportant and looked down on, but I do not forget your rules.
Your goodness lasts forever, and your law is true.
Trouble and pain have come to me, but your commands are my delight.
Your laws are always right. Give me understanding so I may live.
Qoph. I call with all my heart. LORD, answer me! I will obey your laws.
I call out to you. Save me, and I will keep your laws.
I get up before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
I stay awake through the night so I can think about your promises.
Hear my voice because of your faithful love. LORD, give me new life, as your judgments promise.
Those who plan evil are coming close to me, but they are far from your law.
But you are near, LORD, and all your commands are true.
Long ago I learned from your laws that you made them to last forever.
Resh. Look at my suffering and rescue me, because I have not forgotten your law.
Defend my cause and rescue me. Give me new life, as you promised.
Wicked people are far from being saved, because they do not look for your laws.
LORD, your mercy is great. Give me new life, as your judgments promise.
Many enemies chase and attack me, but I have not turned away from your laws.
I look at unfaithful people with disgust, because they do not obey your word.
See how I love your rules. LORD, give me new life because of your faithful love.
All your words are true. All your fair judgments last forever.
Sin and Shin. Rulers chase me for no reason, but my heart is in awe of your word.
I am happy about your promise, like someone who finds great treasure.
I hate and despise lies, but I love your law.
Seven times a day I praise you because your judgments are right.
Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing makes them stumble.
LORD, I hope for your rescue, and I follow your commands.
I obey your laws with all my heart. I love them very much.
I obey your rules and your laws, because you see everything I do.
Tav. LORD, let my cry come to you. Give me understanding, as your word promises.
Let my prayer come to you. Rescue me, as you promised.
Let my lips overflow with praise, because you teach me your laws.
Let my tongue sing about your word, because all your commands are right.
Let your hand be ready to help me, because I have chosen your rules.
LORD, I long for your rescue. Your law is my delight.
Let me live so I can praise you. Let your judgments help me.
I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Come and look for me, your servant, because I have not forgotten your commands.
